audit.runtime_limitation: Sandbox has no browser and no network. No live rendering, computed-box measurement, real screenshots, or keyboard/screen-reader passes were possible. All runtime-dependent items are marked NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

findings.title: Currency zone <select> at 14px triggers iOS Safari focus-zoom
findings.detail: `.currency-zone__head select` uses font 600 14px/1. Viewport (index.html:5) is width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover with NO maximum-scale/user-scalable=no, so iOS Safari auto-zooms on focus of any form control < 16px.
findings.proposed_fix: Raise the select font-size to >=16px (or set 16px on focus). Do not disable user zoom.

findings.title: Booking-note <textarea> at 15px triggers iOS Safari focus-zoom
findings.detail: `.fd-note-edit__field` is a textarea (rows=3, maxlength=2000) at font-size 15px. Focusing to edit a booking note triggers iOS zoom for the same viewport reason as C1.
findings.proposed_fix: Raise textarea font-size to >=16px.

findings.title: Flight/Hotel/Train(Ferry) detail screens expose zero headings
findings.detail: appBar() renders the visible screen title as <strong> not a heading (mobile-app.js:3339), and these detail bodies emit no h1/h2. Verified 0 h1 / 0 h2 in those screens. The generic Plan detail DOES include an <h1 class=fd-title> (mobile-app.js:4724), so the omission is inconsistent, not intentional.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a body-level <h1> to the three detail screens, or promote appBar()'s <strong> to <h1> app-wide.

findings.title: Notifications empty-state uses <h3> with no h1/h2 above it (skipped level)
findings.detail: The only <h3> in the app ('You're all caught up') sits inside the notifications sheet with no higher heading level above it.
findings.proposed_fix: Normalize to <h2> to match the sheet's heading level.

findings.title: Dead --app-width override and hardcoded 600 literal
findings.detail: The per-screen `--app-width:600px` override at 3270 is identical to :root (line 37) and is a no-op. Line 3306 hardcodes `width:min(100%,600px)` for .bottom-sheet instead of `var(--app-width)`; same value today, will drift if the token changes.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove the redundant override; replace the 600 literal with var(--app-width).

findings.title: Welcome 'Take a tour' and legal links below 44px usability target
findings.detail: Both are >=24px (meet WCAG 2.2 AA 24px floor) but below the 44px comfortable-touch target.
findings.proposed_fix: Raise min-height to 44px.

findings.title: Discard/confirm dialog (z100) can render behind full-screen picker/doc-viewer (z120)
findings.detail: If a discard/confirm dialog is raised while a full-screen picker, place-search, or doc-viewer is open (e.g. abandoning an unsaved place search), the dialog would sit behind the z120 layer and be invisible/unclickable. Needs runtime check of the abandon-unsaved-search flow.
findings.proposed_fix: Raise the discard-dialog backdrop above 120, or ensure full-screen layers close before a dialog opens.

findings.title: google-auth-recovery header lacks env(safe-area-inset-top)
findings.detail: This framed header is not .app-header, so it misses the top-inset rule at css:280; the frame >header rule (3282) only sets padding-inline. On a notched device the brand line may sit under the status bar/notch.
findings.proposed_fix: Add padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top) to the recovery header.

findings.title: Loading screen fills only 55svh, empty paper below
findings.detail: .thinking-stage has min-height:55svh while .phone-app base is min-height:100dvh, so the branded splash may leave ~45% empty paper below. Needs visual check.
findings.proposed_fix: Center the splash within full viewport height.

findings.title: Empty-booking and error screens bypass the flex frame (no <main>)
findings.detail: Both are `.screen` without a direct `main`, so the html:has(.phone-app>.screen>main) frame does not activate; they fall back to the legacy fixed-nav scrolling-document model. Internally consistent but a different layout model than framed screens.
findings.proposed_fix: Wrap their content in <main> so they use the unified frame, or confirm the legacy model is acceptable.

findings.title: muted-soft text on --surface computes 4.34:1 (below AA 4.5)
findings.detail: muted-soft passes on --paper (4.69:1) and --card (4.95:1) but only 4.34:1 on --surface. No confirmed placement of muted-soft text directly on a --surface fill was found; any small note (e.g. currency-disclaimer/esim-note) rendered inside a --surface card would fail. Verify no such combination ships.
findings.proposed_fix: Use --muted (5.68:1 on paper) for any small text on --surface, or darken --muted-soft.

findings.title: Past timeline marker border is near-invisible on pastel fill
findings.detail: .timeline-screen--ribbon .journey-event--past .journey-marker border-color rgba(255,255,255,.6) on light pastel fills (flight-soft etc.) is effectively invisible. Appears to be intentional de-emphasis (marker fill still visible). Flagging as an invisible-border instance.
findings.proposed_fix: If the border is meant to read, use a visible tone; otherwise document as intentional.

findings.title: Latent 'designed-for-dark' base rules shadowed only by html-prefixed overrides
findings.detail: Multiple base rules declare white/near-white text on what are actually light backgrounds; effective styles are safe ONLY because of the html-prefixed re-theme block and .welcome-thread ancestor overrides. If any override selector is renamed or a wrapper class dropped, white-on-white/paper resurfaces. No active invisible-text bug found today.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove the dead dark base declarations rather than shadowing them.

findings.title: Many important titles use single-line nowrap-ellipsis with no touch reveal
findings.detail: Trip name, journey headline, place names, airport names, booking-detail rows, trip-card titles, currency names, date-range summary, attachment/document/email titles, etc. all clip with ellipsis. On a touch PWA there is no hover, so overflow is permanently hidden. The clip mechanism is CONFIRMED; whether real content overflows depends on content length/locale (hence NEEDS_VERIFICATION).
findings.proposed_fix: Allow 2-line wrap on the most content-variable titles (trip name, place names, booking titles), or verify representative long strings.

findings.title: Welcome uses 700/701px breakpoints on a 520px-capped column
findings.detail: Viewport-driven type bumps at 700/701 apply to a .phone-app welcome element capped at 520px. Harmless but semantically stale.
findings.proposed_fix: Align welcome breakpoints to its actual 520 column or to viewport intent.

findings.title: bookings .intro-block direct .screen child not targeted by frame rules
findings.detail: The frame styles only >header/>main/>.mobile-alert/>.bottom-nav/>.app-bar direct children. bookings places an .intro-block div directly under .screen; it becomes a default flex item above the scroll area and could steal height on short screens.
findings.proposed_fix: Move .intro-block inside <main> or give it flex:0 0 auto explicitly.

findings.title: Modal focus order, role=switch and combobox announcements need AT verification
findings.detail: Static code shows correct patterns (aria-modal, inert background, Tab traps, Escape, focus return, aria-activedescendant). Actual focus order, trap behavior, and screen-reader announcements cannot be verified without a browser/AT.
findings.proposed_fix: Run VoiceOver/keyboard passes on modals, the round-trip switch, and the destination combobox.

findings.title: Sub-13px secondary body text on descriptive copy
findings.detail: Secondary/description copy at 12-12.5px is borderline for sustained reading (labels/badges at 12px are fine). Non-integer 12.5px is also unusual.
findings.proposed_fix: Consider 13-14px for descriptive body copy; use integer px.

findings.title: Promote appBar() title to a real <h1> app-wide
findings.detail: The app-bar title is <strong> on every screen. Making it a semantic heading fixes C3 uniformly and improves screen-reader navigation everywhere.
findings.proposed_fix: Render the app-bar title as <h1>.

findings.title: Use var(--app-width) consistently instead of literal widths
findings.location: public/mobile-app.css:3306 and any future width literal
findings.detail: Keeps the single-column width authoritative in one token.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace literals with the token.
